blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY—A total of more than 81 kilograms of spoiled fish were confiscated by city authorities during an inspection of supermarkets in the city’s central business district and along Magsaysay Avenue recently. In a statement on Friday (Nov. 6), the Baguio City Public Information Office said the Meat and Fishery Products Monitoring Task Force issued a notice of violations to a local supermarket. The violations allegedly involve the alleged use of deceptive lighting and the display of meat and fish together.
